dataSource.query:
AIQSnapshotRunsV1(_startTime, _endTime, 'swedencentral', 'unique-issues-noise-1-duplicate-05-miss-025-v2')
| project Value = FrameworkRunId, Label = strcat(format_datetime(ReportDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), ' / ', FrameworkRunId), ReportDate
| order by ReportDate desc
| project Value, Label

let Selected = AIQSnapshotRunsV1(_startTime, _endTime, 'swedencentral', 'unique-issues-noise-1-duplicate-05-miss-025-v2', true)
| where ReportDate >= startofday(_startTime)
| where isempty(_snapshot) or FrameworkRunId == _snapshot
| sort by ReportDate desc, SnapshotOrder desc
| take 1;
let RunIds = coalesce(toscalar(Selected | project pack_array(FrameworkRunId, PreviousRunId)), dynamic([]));
AIQUnitsV1(RunIds)
| extend Value = iff(Kind == 'baseline', 'Baseline', TestCategory)
| where Value in ('Baseline', 'context_memory', 'cost_tokens', 'hallucinations', 'latency', 'output_quality', 'reliability_errors', 'safety_guardrails', 'tool_call_failures')
| distinct Value
| project Value, Label = iff(Value == 'Baseline', 'Baseline — global penalties only', Value)
| order by Value asc

let Selected = AIQSnapshotRunsV1(_startTime, _endTime, 'swedencentral', 'unique-issues-noise-1-duplicate-05-miss-025-v2', true)
| where ReportDate >= startofday(_startTime)
| where isempty(_snapshot) or FrameworkRunId == _snapshot
| sort by ReportDate desc, SnapshotOrder desc
| take 1;
let RunIds = coalesce(toscalar(Selected | project pack_array(FrameworkRunId, PreviousRunId)), dynamic([]));
AIQUnitsV1(RunIds)
| where isempty(_testCategory) or (_testCategory == 'Baseline' and Kind == 'baseline') or (Kind == 'issue' and TestCategory == _testCategory)
| project Value = Agent, Label = Agent
| distinct Value, Label
| order by Value asc

tiles.query:
let Latest = materialize(AIQSnapshotRunsV1(_startTime, _endTime, 'swedencentral', 'unique-issues-noise-1-duplicate-05-miss-025-v2')
| sort by ReportDate desc, SnapshotOrder desc
| take 1);
union
(Latest | project ReportDate, QualityScore, C_E = strcat(CorrectIssues, '/', ExpectedIssues), M = MissedIssues, N = NoiseCards, D = DuplicateCards, ExcludedUnits, Publication = 'Published'),
(print ReportDate = datetime(null), QualityScore = real(null), C_E = '', M = long(null), N = long(null), D = long(null), ExcludedUnits = long(null), Publication = 'No official public-safe v2 publications in Sweden Central for these dates. Select another range; never publish private TEST data to populate this dashboard.'
| where toscalar(Latest | count) == 0)
tiles.title: Latest stored v2 quality — C/E detected/scored; M misses; N Noise; D Duplicates
Scores by category — stored test-category quality; Baseline = separate global penalties, not a score

tiles.query:
AIQSnapshotRunsV1(_startTime, _endTime, 'swedencentral', 'unique-issues-noise-1-duplicate-05-miss-025-v2')
| extend Series = strcat('v2 / Sweden Central / ', CoveragePolicy)
| project ReportDate, QualityScore, Series
| order by ReportDate asc
tiles.title: Stored v2 quality trend — Sweden Central; overall is not a category average
Latest vs previous snapshot — count changes and denominator penalties, not causal attribution

tiles.query:
AIQSnapshotChangesV1(_startTime, _endTime, 'swedencentral', 'unique-issues-noise-1-duplicate-05-miss-025-v2')
| project ReportDate, PreviousDate, IssueCoverage = strcat(ScoredIssues, '/', PlannedIssues), PreviousIssues = iff(isempty(PreviousRunId), '', strcat(PreviousScoredIssues, '/', PreviousPlannedIssues)), BaselineCoverage = strcat(ScoredBaselines, '/', PlannedBaselines), PreviousBaselines = iff(isempty(PreviousRunId), '', strcat(PreviousScoredBaselines, '/', PreviousPlannedBaselines)), ExcludedUnits, PreviousExcluded, ComparisonNote
| order by ReportDate desc
tiles.title: Coverage and comparison limits — scored/planned units; excluded units are not misses
Filtered Agent counts — each snapshot's test-category membership; no per-Agent quality score
Units in either category snapshot — same-unit deltas, not category attribution; blank means absent/excluded/inapplicable
Filtered findings — current/prior unit test category, not card category; scored/unscored remain separate

tiles.query:
let Selected = materialize(AIQSnapshotRunsV1(_startTime, _endTime, 'swedencentral', 'unique-issues-noise-1-duplicate-05-miss-025-v2')
| where isempty(_snapshot) or FrameworkRunId == _snapshot
| sort by ReportDate desc, SnapshotOrder desc
| take 1);
let SelectedRunIds = toscalar(Selected | summarize make_set(FrameworkRunId));
union
(AIQSnapshotChangesV1(_startTime, _endTime, 'swedencentral', 'unique-issues-noise-1-duplicate-05-miss-025-v2', SelectedRunIds)
| join kind=leftouter (AIQCategoryChangesV1(_startTime, _endTime, 'swedencentral', 'unique-issues-noise-1-duplicate-05-miss-025-v2', SelectedRunIds)
    | summarize Categories = make_list(bag_pack('TestCategory', Category, 'Availability', Availability, 'Comparison', CategoryComparisonNote)) by FrameworkRunId) on FrameworkRunId
| project ReportDate, PreviousDate, QualityScore, PreviousScore, ComparisonNote, CategoryContext = bag_pack('Categories', Categories, 'FilterHelp', 'Choose Test category; All includes legacy uncategorized issues. Empty filtered rows are not zero counts. Baseline contains global penalties only. Filters never change global scores/comparison.'), Metadata = bag_pack('FrameworkRunId', FrameworkRunId, 'PreviousRunId', PreviousRunId, 'SourceCommit', SourceCommit, 'PreviousSourceCommit', PreviousSourceCommit, 'Region', Region, 'ScoringPolicy', ScoringPolicy, 'ScoreFormula', ScoreFormula, 'NoiseWeight', NoiseWeight, 'DuplicateWeight', DuplicateWeight, 'MissWeight', MissWeight, 'CoveragePolicy', CoveragePolicy)),
(print ReportDate = datetime(null), PreviousDate = datetime(null), QualityScore = real(null), PreviousScore = real(null), ComparisonNote = 'No official public-safe v2 snapshot in Sweden Central matches these filters. Select All (latest) or another date range. Private TEST results are never published here.', CategoryContext = dynamic(null), Metadata = dynamic(null)
| where toscalar(Selected | count) == 0)
tiles.title: Unfiltered global comparison — expand CategoryContext for unavailable history/limits; Metadata for source/policy
